title: Argentine Navy detects vessel fishing inside EEZ
description: During Operation Mare Nostrum VI, ARA Almirante Storni with P-3 Orion support detected a foreign vessel fishing inside Argentina's EEZ.
notes: Part of Dec 2-7 2025 operation; ~360 Chinese vessels at EEZ edge

title: Lu Qing Yuan Yu 205 displays grid-pattern maneuvering
description: Vessel Lu Qing Yuan Yu 205 observed conducting slow grid-pattern maneuvers suggestive of ocean floor mapping rather than fishing, near Argentine EEZ boundary.
notes: Mapping behavior documented during Mare Nostrum VI

title: 380 DWF vessels massed at Argentine EEZ boundary
description: During Operation Mare Nostrum I, 380 fishing vessels identified along ~100-mile stretch just outside EEZ. Argentine Navy intercepted Chinese vessels attempting entry.
notes: Western Hemisphere DWF presence; Monroe Doctrine relevance

title: Argentine Navy blocks ~300 Chinese squid jiggers
description: Approximately 300 Chinese squid jiggers intercepted and blocked from entering Argentine EEZ.
notes: Recurring annual pattern during squid season

title: 92% of AIS shutoffs in Argentine EEZ area attributed to Chinese vessels
description: CNN analysis of AIS data found Chinese-flagged vessels account for 92% of all AIS disabling events in waters adjacent to Argentina's EEZ.
notes: 13 vessels documented using flags of convenience (Cameroon; Vanuatu)

title: 53 AIS shutoff events near Galapagos EEZ
description: Oceana analysis found 53 instances of Chinese vessels disabling AIS for nearly 27000 cumulative hours near Galapagos EEZ boundary (Jan 2021 - Aug 2023).
notes: 510 Chinese vessels total in study period; 479 were squid jiggers

title: Chinese DWF fleet masses at Galapagos EEZ boundary
description: Up to 510 Chinese-flagged fishing vessels documented operating within 200nm of Galapagos EEZ border. 69% of China's worldwide squid jigging fleet deployed here.
notes: Recurring annual pattern; Western Hemisphere presence

title: Fu Yuan Yu Leng 999 captured inside Galapagos marine reserve
description: Chinese vessel Fu Yuan Yu Leng 999 intercepted inside Galapagos marine reserve carrying 300 tons of marine wildlife including endangered sharks. 20 crew jailed; $5.9M fine.

title: 6 Chinese fishing boats seized in South Korean EEZ
description: South Korea's Ministry of Oceans and Coast Guard seized 6 Chinese fishing boats for illegal fishing in Yellow Sea EEZ. Fines totaling 240 million won (~$163K).
notes: Part of joint crackdown; 241 Chinese boats inspected

title: 15 illegal gill nets found near Jeju Island
description: Inspection of Chinese fishing vessels found 15 illegal gill nets deployed near Jeju Island within South Korean EEZ.
notes: Gill nets being removed by Korean authorities

title: Chinese crew resists boarding with iron bars and steel barriers
description: Two 300-ton Chinese fishing boats found inside EEZ. Crew armed with iron bars ignored stop orders and erected steel barriers to prevent boarding. Special forces boarded; found 2 tons of illegal sardines and 1-inch mesh nets (vs 21-inch legal minimum).

title: Chinese DWF longliners active near American Samoa
description: Half of South Pacific albacore catch taken by Chinese longliners. Tuna cannery on American Samoa temporarily suspended operations due to fish stock depletion. USCG evaluating Fast Response Cutter basing.
notes: Chronic presence zone; direct US economic impact

title: Chinese DWF vessel attempts to ram USCGC James
description: USCGC James took evasive action to avoid a Chinese-flagged DWF vessel that attempted to ram the cutter in the Pacific during fisheries enforcement patrol.

title: 90% of Ghana's industrial trawl fleet is Chinese-owned through front companies
description: 137 Chinese DWF vessels registered via Ghanaian front companies despite laws forbidding foreign ownership. Over 100K tonnes of illegally caught fish transshipped annually.
notes: Systemic pattern; artisanal fishers report 40% income decline

title: Chang Hui 2 intercepted fishing in restricted Ivorian waters
description: Ivorian patrol forces with French Navy intercepted Chang Hui 2 fishing in restricted waters off Ivory Coast.

title: Dalian Ruitaifeng sends vessels to Guinea despite prior IUU suspension
description: Chinese company Dalian Ruitaifeng (formerly Dalian Lianrun) found sending refurbished vessels to Guinea despite 2018 suspension by China's Ministry of Agriculture for IUU violations.
notes: Company suspended in 2018 for illegal nets and unlicensed shark fishing

title: 6 Chinese vessels caught violating catch-recording rules in Vanuatu
description: Six Chinese fishing vessels found violating catch-recording regulations in Vanuatu's EEZ. USCG involved in boarding operations.
notes: US Coast Guard assisted with enforcement
